headline: Property stocks PF and RML plunge 20% each while consumer and agribusiness shares rally on strong volume.
market_take: The PROP sector led the market lower with PF and RML down 20.00% and CGD off 10.00%, all on modest volume. Consumer (CONS) and agriculture (AGRI) showed the strongest upside, highlighted by ITD (+8.82%) and TRC (+8.62%) on high volume, and TL (+6.82%) with a 5.0σ volume spike. Unusual‑trading alerts were concentrated in consumer and PFREIT names, and several high‑profile filings this week include a connected transaction for CMC (PROP) and a delisting notice for GLAND (PROP).

sector_notes.note: PF and RML each fell 20.00% (vol×1.15 and vol×0.51) and CGD dropped 10.00%; PLAT rose 5.07%. Filings this week include a connected transaction for CMC and a delisting notice for GLAND.
ITD (+8.82%) and TRC (+8.62%) led gains with volume spikes of 4.2σ and 4.9σ respectively; APCS posted a 25.4σ volume spike. TPOLY showed an 11.11% open gap and a -10.00% intraday move.
TL surged 6.82% on a 5.0σ volume spike and a +9.30% intraday move; SMO reported completion of a capital restructuring.
AQUA experienced a -10.00% open gap but rebounded +11.11% intraday; CHOTI rose 5.34% on strong volume.
EPG and SKN each gained 5.00%; SCC added 4.90%. VNG posted a 6.8σ volume spike.
TTLPF fell 4.91% with a -6.13% open gap; AXTRART showed a 3.0σ volume spike; TU-PF recorded a -100.00% open gap. PROSPECT filed a capital‑change notice.
